name: Mapletree Industrial Trust
summary: Mapletree Industrial Trust is a real estate investment trust, and its principal investment strategy is to invest in a diversified portfolio of income-producing real estate used primarily for industrial purposes in Singapore and income producing real estate used primarily as data centres worldwide beyond Singapore, as well as real estate-related assets. As at 30 September 2026, MIT's total assets under management was S8.3 billion dollars, which comprised 79 properties in Singapore, 53 properties in North America (including 13 data centres held through the joint venture with Mapletree Investments Pte Ltd) and two properties in Japan.
